description: No captured source supplies simultaneous attendance for the 22–23 October Aktau heating protest.
The Aktobe report establishes about 100 public protesters and an employer bonus dispute, but captured evidence does not establish state ownership/control or a demand directed to government.
TIREK mentions initiative speakers advocating a vote and moratorium, but this captured passage does not establish a public gathering, date/location sufficient for an event record, or crowd size.
Open-web searches are non-exhaustive. Official baseline and historical originals were unavailable in this workspace; current source ledger alone cannot prove absence or coverage completeness.
